title: Singer 2 only in the wedges

complaints.says: I can hear myself fine, but my family says they couldn’t hear me at all.

hints: The wedge works, so the mic, cable and channel are fine. What's different about the path to the room?
cause: Vox 2 wasn't assigned to Main, so it went to the monitor mixes but never to the room.
lesson: A channel can feed the wedges without feeding the room. The Main assign button decides whether a channel goes to the mains.
